# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Seasoned Senior Quality Engineer with over 19 years of experience delivering end-to-end test strategies, automation frameworks, and quality architecture across cloud platforms and hardware-integrated software systems. Highly skilled in test planning, execution, and automation using C#, .NET, SQL, and Python to validate complex distributed architectures and critical operational workflows. Collaborative QA leader with proven success spearheading code reviews, defect triage, and cross-functional release management to ensure exceptional product reliability.

- **CI/CD & DevOps:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitHub, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF)
